selection_policy: Calendar windows fixed before new fitting, after inspecting development label availability and existing validation block results. Retrospective development diagnostics, not untouched evaluations or a hyperparameter search.
fitting_policy: Select XGBoost tree count on a past seven-day inner stopping window with a preceding seven-day feature-date gap. Refit that fixed count on all available past development rows up to the outer seven-day gap. Logistic uses these same refitting rows. Never pass outer outcomes to fitting or early stopping.
missing_class_policy: If inner fitting or stopping lacks either class, mark XGBoost unavailable for that window; do not borrow future labels or choose a fallback based on outer scores. Keep the window and other models.
comparison_policy: Both reviewed feature sets, persistence and past training prevalence; all rows and the no-current-detection subset. Report daily and fixed three-day validation slices without claiming they are independent of original early stopping.
final_test_policy: No final-test parsing, prediction, calibration or scores
